description: This dataset contains coral isotope measurements from the Porites species, including Sr/Ca, Mg/Ca, δ18O, and δ13C ratios, which are key indicators of past climate conditions. The data spans from 2000 to 2007, with measurements taken at a fixed location in French Polynesia (latitude -17.506944, longitude -149.4225, elevation -15.0 meters). Each record includes temporal (Age, Age_2, Date/Time) and spatial (Latitude, Longitude, Elevation) metadata, along with an event identifier. The semantic profile highlights climate-related measurements, making this dataset valuable for paleoclimate research, coral growth studies, and environmental reconstructions. Researchers can use it to analyze historical temperature variations, ocean chemistry changes, and coral response to climate shifts.
